entities.name: Cross-Border Telehealth Platform
entities.description: A multi-region cross-border telehealth platform providing video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for EU and US patients while enforcing strict regional data residency and regulatory compliance under GDPR, HIPAA, and EU MDR.

entities.name: Patients
entities.description: Users accessing care, managing consent, and utilizing the AI symptom checker.

entities.name: Licensed Clinicians
entities.description: Healthcare providers delivering video consultations and issuing cross-border e-prescriptions.

entities.name: Compliance Officers
entities.description: Overseeing audit trails, AI traceability, and data residency.

entities.name: Video Infrastructure Provider
entities.description: Third-party WebRTC SFU handling low-bandwidth consultations.

entities.name: AI Inference Engine
entities.description: External LLM service providing urgency recommendations.

entities.name: Regional Pharmacy Gateways
entities.description: External HL7 FHIR APIs (US) and national gateways (EU) for e-prescription delivery.

entities.name: Identity & Consent Providers
entities.description: Regional OIDC/OAuth2 authentication and consent management services.

interfaces.description: Accesses care, manages consent, and utilizes AI symptom checker
Delivers video consultations and issues e-prescriptions
Oversees audit trails, AI traceability, and data residency
Handles real-time video streaming for consultations
Sends symptom evaluation requests and receives urgencies
Delivers e-prescriptions to US and EU pharmacies

naming_conventions: External systems are named with descriptive plural or architectural roles (e.g., 'Regional Pharmacy Gateways', 'Identity & Consent Providers').
Actors/Persons are named in plural form representing user roles ('Patients', 'Licensed Clinicians', 'Compliance Officers').
